seo.description: Ordering from Bonza is simple: pick your perfume, then send us a direct message on Instagram or TikTok. Here is how it works.

sections.heading: Order your perfume by DM
sections.subheading: At Bonza, every order starts with a simple direct message: tell us which fragrance you would like, and we take it from there.

sections.heading: Three simple steps
sections.subheading: From first look to your order, all in one conversation.

items.title: Choose your perfume
items.text: Browse our men's and women's eau de parfum, eau de toilette for men and eau de parfum gift sets on the Perfumes page, and pick the one you like.

items.title: Send us a DM
items.text: Message us on Instagram or TikTok at bonza_perfumes. Tell us the name of the perfume you would like to order.

items.title: Finish in the chat
items.text: We continue the conversation with you directly in your DMs, so your order stays in one friendly place.
